items.source: Will only be used if the ResourceAdapter does not invoke the endpoint's beforeDelivery and afterDelivery directly, leaving it up to the concrete endpoint to apply those - and to handle any ResourceExceptions thrown from them.
items.translation: 仅在资源适配器不直接调用端点的 `beforeDelivery` 和 `afterDelivery` 时才会使用，将其交由具体端点应用这些方法并处理由此抛出的任何 `ResourceException`。
